newsitem.title: JAPAN: ASAHI CHEM SEES REVENUE FROM BATTERY PATENT--PAPER.
newsitem.headline: ASAHI CHEM SEES REVENUE FROM BATTERY PATENT--PAPER.

text.p: Asahi Chemical Industry Co expects to earn more than 30 billion yen in licensing charges in the next 15 years from domestically patented technology for lithium-ion batteries, the business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported on Friday.
Demand for such batteries is growing rapidly for use in personal computers and mobile phones.
Asahi Chemical will begin charging Japanese manufacturers, including Sony Corp, for the patent by the end of August, the paper said.
Asahi Chemical plans to charge royalties of one to two percent of shipment value, it said.
A spokesman for the company was not immediately available to confirm the report.
